title: Regulator notification overrun — count of statutory-window breaches (ransomware)
summary: Count of confirmed-ransomware events in window whose regulator notification was emitted after the applicable statutory deadline (NIS2 Article 23 24-hour early warning; DORA Article 19 4-hour initial report). A non-zero value is a residual-risk signal: even one overrun is a regulatory-exposure event for the operator, independent of how well the operational containment loop performed.

target.rationale: Zero tolerance: any overrun is a regulatory-exposure event.

measurement.formula: count( incidents where comms_plan.notification.dispatched_at > statutory_deadline(incident.classified_at) ) over window.

external_refs.name: NIS2 Directive (EU) 2022/2555, Article 23 — incident reporting obligations
DORA Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Article 19 — reporting of major ICT-related incidents
